# Check A02-09: chongqizhiqian → 重启之前

Tatakikun with the new Chinese pack is already installed on this Mac (scripts/install.sh, 2026-10-21).

1. Switch to Tatakikun in any app (TextEdit, Notes).
2. Type `chongqizhiqian`: 重启之前 is in the bar (third); press its number or click it.
3. Type `chongqi`: 重启 is second.
4. Type a few words you use often (woaini, yinhang, nihao, zhongguo, …) and check the first candidate is still the one you expect.
